text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
Ocean Centurion - (built 1979) 130,370 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $5.7 million.
Baltic Flame - (built 1992) sold to Finnish buyers for for $70 million.
Mar Caterina - (built 1992) 14,534 dwt sold to U.S. buyers for $5 million.
Splendour - (built 1977) 24,185 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $4.5 million with three years timecharter back at $7,800 daily.
CMB EBONY - (built 1977) 21,181 dwt plus sistership: Woermann Expert - (built 1977) 21,181 dwt sold tofor $10 million enbloc with three years timecharter at $8,300 daily.
Ocean Centurion - (built 1979) 130,370 dwt sold for $5.7 million.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to survey, inspection or other conditions.
